WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    zc.city, 
    COUNT(*) as attendee_count
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN zip_code zc ON m.zip = zc.zip_code
  GROUP BY zc.city
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(attendee_count) as total_attendees
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.city,
    s1.attendee_count,
    CAST(s1.attendee_count AS REAL) / s2.total_attendees as proportion
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_attendees IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.city,
    s3.attendee_count,
    s3.proportion,
    s3.proportion - s4.avg_proportion as deviation
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.proportion > s4.avg_proportion
)
SELECT 
  AVG(attendee_count),
  AVG(proportion),
  AVG(deviation)
FROM step5
